extraction_notes: SS36-E3/57T is the SS36 device with the 57T tape-and-reel package suffix; electrical data are specified for the SS36 family member.

The datasheet electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF = 0.75 V at IF = 3.0 A for SS35 and SS36, and maximum reverse current of 0.5 mA at TA = 25 degC and 10 mA at TA = 100 degC at rated DC blocking voltage; SS36 rated blocking voltage is 60 V.

The forward-characteristics, reverse-current, capacitance, thermal-derating, surge-current, and transient-thermal-impedance curves were digitized from the plotted graphs; points are approximate readings of the printed curves and are not interpolated table values.
The capacitance plot is labeled in pF; curve values were converted to F for the SI-valued output.
No reverse-recovery time is published; Schottky reverse recovery is not available as a datasheet scalar for this part.
No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current measurement is published; VRRM/VDC = 60 V is an absolute maximum/rating and is not treated as a breakdown point.
